name: pyg-data-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is PyG (PyTorch Geometric), a library for deep learning on graphs. This task
concerns its graph data handling: the `Data`, `HeteroData`, `Batch`, `TemporalData` and `HyperGraphData`
containers, mini-batching and collation, datasets (`Dataset`, `InMemoryDataset`, `OnDiskDataset`), and the graph
transforms in `torch_geometric.transforms`.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the torch_geometric/data and torch_geometric/transforms packages (every Python module in them) except these modules, which are out of scope: torch_geometric/data/download.py, the whole torch_geometric/data/lightning/ subpackage, torch_geometric/transforms/knn_graph.py, torch_geometric/transforms/radius_graph.py, torch_geometric/transforms/grid_sampling.py, torch_geometric/transforms/to_superpixels.py and torch_geometric/transforms/add_gpse.py; together with the documentation pages docs/source/get_started/introduction.rst, docs/source/advanced/batching.rst, docs/source/tutorial/create_dataset.rst, docs/source/tutorial/heterogeneous.rst and docs/source/tutorial/dataset_splitting.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is tho
